notes: Per frame: optional event, then fx.update(lever, ab, pos, quat, vel) `updates` times (sweep read from the source), then the afterburner and trail render-list calls with a camera at `camera`. Defs: f22 = AircraftDefs.F22(), others = aircraft.json packs by id. Cone geometries are keyed by the FNV-1a of their float32 position bytes (see geometries). Trail matrices/levels: FNV-1a of the drawn float32 prefix (count*16 / count); every 100th frame also in full (with the plume group world positions). bindModel feeds LOD0 vertices from models[name]. plumes = world position of the plume group (0.5 m ahead of the root).
